newsitem.title: USA: TRW, Magna in vehicle safety systems pact.
newsitem.headline: TRW, Magna in vehicle safety systems pact.

text.p: TRW Inc and Magna International Inc said Monday they had agreed to form a strategic alliance to design, develop and produce automotive products.

In a joint statement, the companies said TRW will lead development efforts in air bags, seat belts, inflators, sensors and steering wheels, while Magna will focus on complete vehicle interiors and total body systems.
As part of the deal, TRW will buy an 80 percent equity interest in two Magna-owned operations -- MST Automotive GmbH Automobil-Sicherheitstechnik and Temic Bayern-Chemie Airbag GmbH.

MST is a European supplier of air bag modules, steering wheels and other related automotive components. Temic is a European supplier of air bag inflators and propellants and related automotive components.

Magna will buy the stakes in the two companies that it does not already own, from Temic Telefunken Microelectronic GmbH, and then sell an 80 percent interest in the pair to TRW for $418 million cash, the companies said.
The companies also said they will operate a technical center to focus on total vehicle safety system integration.
